rv.q: But all this (literal, enjoyable) pissing about disguises the crux of the matter.

In Tony Roper’s new touring production for Rerr Terr Productions, Louise McCarthy, Ali Cleland, Eden Barrie and Lesley Mackie bring all four characters brilliantly to life, relishing every moment of legendary comic sequences including the imaginary phone call to Drumchapel, and Mrs Culfeathers’s mighty Galloway’s mince story.

Maureen Carr's production flits between the play's sitcom-style banter and the educational pamphlet it becomes as Lauren, Pat and Aaliyah confront a few ugly home truths on their collective doorstep before finding a very necessary sense of solidarity.
